verdict_text:
NO

The merge computes the second task vector against the already-modified base instead of the unmodified one: `tmp = b + λ(f1 - b)` and then `tmp + λ(f2 - tmp)`. This yields `0.36·base + 0.24·ft1 + 0.4·ft2` rather than the required `0.2·base + 0.4·ft1 + 0.4·ft2`, so the 48 merged tensors will fail the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance. This violates "Required result" step 2, which specifies `out[X] = base[X] + λ(ft1[X] - base[X]) + λ(ft2[X] - base[X])`, and is exactly the ordering hazard the Objective section warns about. The verification, tensor counts, dtype handling, and output path otherwise match the specification.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
